objectives.statement: Use den, det, and de before adjectives and definite nouns.
Build noun phrases with a front possessive such as min before an adjective and noun.
Find and fix common order and agreement errors inside noun phrases.
Recognize the main word order inside a Bokmål noun phrase.

notes: Must teach order inside Bokmål noun phrases: demonstratives, possessives, adjectives, and definiteness. Coordinate with double_definiteness and adjective_definite_forms.
